tasks.fix: Render the <main> on the server (SSR/SSG) in the initial HTML, using the same markup the client renders, so hydration does not add or replace it.

tasks.title: A list contains invalid direct children
tasks.problem: A <ul> or <ol> has a direct child that is not an <li> (or a script-supporting element). Observed pattern: ul>div×4 (1 pages).
tasks.reason: Only <li>, <script>, and <template> are allowed as children of lists. Wrapping items in <div> or nesting a bare <ul> breaks list semantics.
tasks.fix: Move wrappers inside the <li>, or restructure so every direct child of the list is an <li>.
